firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Dear Google DeepMind and Kaggle Teams,

I am writing to respectfully request a brief grace period or technical assistance to finalize the submission of my competition write-up.

All sections of my write-up—including the full text, supporting media, and code/notebook links—were completed, uploaded, and saved as a draft on Kaggle prior to the deadline. Unfortunately, due to a minor last-minute delay, I missed the final submission cutoff by approximately 5 minutes due to my time zone issue and am now locked out from clicking the submit button.

To ensure transparency and verify that the content was finalized without any post-deadline modifications, I have also published the timestamped write-up on Zenodo, which can be accessed directly here: **https://zenodo.org/records/24159160**

Because the entire draft is already saved on Kaggle in its complete state, no further edits are needed. I would be sincerely grateful if the organizing team could either allow the saved draft to be officially submitted or advise if there is an alternative procedure to have it considered for evaluation. 

I request you to please allow me to submit my write-up, as I invested a lot of my time working on it and couldn't submit it in the end due to my own time zone glitch.🙏🙏🙏

Thank you very much for your time, understanding, and for hosting such a great competition.

Best regards,
Moez Ur Rehman
